title: Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of 'GLA5PR GLARS-NF1 Tab.' in Peripheral Neuropathic Pain
brief_summary: A multi-center, randomized, double-blind, parallel, active-controlled phase III clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of 'GLA5PR GLARS-NF1 Tab.' and 'Pregabalin' in peripheral neuropathic pain
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* both male and female who are over 19-year-old
* patient whose pain scale is 4\~9
* patient who has pain of mononeuropathy

Exclusion Criteria:

* patient whose CCr is \<60ml/min
* patient who has other pain which is not from mononeuropathy
* patient who is going to have an operation during this study
* patient who has abnormal ECG
